Legal Opinion No. 95 s. 2011 LEGAL SERVICE DEC 29 2011 MAYOR CELESTINO E. MARTINEZ, JR. City of Bogo, Cebu Dear Mayor Martinez, Jr: This has reference to your 12 December 2011 letter seeking guidance in the implementation of the Order of Regional Director Ananias M. Villacorta of DILG Region VII, directing you to implement the Decision dated 3 June 2011 of the Office of the Ombudsman (Approved by the Over-all Deputy Ombudsman Orlando C. Casimiro on 5 September 2011) in OMB-C-A-08-0498-l, entitled: "Filed Investigation Office (FJO) Rep. by: Eugenio G. Ferrer vs. Rhett E. Minguez and Cresencio P. Verdida", findng respondents Cresencio P. Verdida (Municipal Accountant) and Rhett E. Minguez (Municipal Treasurer) both of that city, guilty of Dishonesty, Conduct Prejudicial to the Best Interest of the Service and Grave Misconduct and meting upon them the penalty of dismissal from the service with accessory penalties of cancellation of eligibility, forfeiture of retirement benefits and perpetual disqualification for reinstatement or re-employment in the government service. However, you were informed that respondent Cresencio P. Verdjda is filing or has filed a petition with the Court of Appeals questioning the said Ombudsman Decision and that there is still a Motion for Reconsideration pending before the Office of the Ombudsman. Hence, the subject request. In reply thereto, please be informed that Memorandum Circular No. 01 s. 2006, dated II April 2006 of the Office of the Ombudsman states that the filing of a Motion for Reconsideration or Petition for review before the Office of the Ombudsman does not operate to stay the immediate implementation of the Ombudsman Decisions, Orders or Resolutions, unless a Temporary Restraining or Writ of Injunction js duly issued by the court of competent jurisdiction. Attached is a copy of Memorandum Circular No. 01 s. 2006 for your ready reference. Based on the aforesaid Memorandum Circular you should immediately implement the said Ombudsman Decision as against respondent Verdida, unless a Temporary Restraining Order or Writ of Injunction is duly issued by the Court of competent jurisdiction. We hope we have addressed your concern accordingly. Very truly yours, J USB Dir CC: Hon. Orlando C. Casimiro Overall Deputy Ombudsman Ombudsman Bldg.,Agham Road Diliman, Quezon City LS/12/07 r Ill
